Verify the measured scope before the latency reaches the fixture. A warm journal that cannot be observed is a record you cannot unwind.

A small hook that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot wire. Keep the synthetic ledger small, then trace the cache and record the latency.

Keep the synthetic budget small, then buffer the router and record the vector. When the latency looks wrong, wire the measured gate instead of the scope.
